title: Fraunhofer HHI VVdeC through 3.2.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability that allows attackers to crash the…
description: Fraunhofer HHI VVdeC versions through 3.2.1 have a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability. This flaw allows attackers to crash the decoder by providing a collocated picture of a different resolution in a crafted VVC bitstream. The vulnerability occurs when TMVP is enabled and error concealment is active, causing the function getColInfo to read beyond allocated memory.
